name: mimg_upload_image
description: Upload a LOCAL image file so it can be used as the source of an edit. Returns {upload_id, status: 'ready'}; pass that id to mimg_edit_image as `upload_id`. Only needed for a file on this machine — to edit an image that is already in the gallery, skip this and pass `source_image_id` to mimg_edit_image instead. The file must live under the agent's upload root (METALCRAFT_UPLOAD_ROOT, default <data>/uploads); files outside it are refused. Image content types only, 20MB limit. Uploading is free — it spends no credits.

file_path.description: Path to the local image file. Must resolve inside the configured upload root (METALCRAFT_UPLOAD_ROOT, default <data>/uploads).
